item.title: County in DC area criticized for using taxpayer funds to counter ICE
item.description: A Virginia county is under scrutiny for a policy that provides taxpayer-funded grants to families of undocumented immigrants whose breadwinner was deported.

item.title: CIA Director Expected to Expand Role in Ukraine Negotiations
item.description: CIA Director John Ratcliffe may take on a larger role in U.S. efforts to end the Russia-Ukraine conflict, according to reports.

Zach Kraft: Trump to Deliver Midterm Message Directly to Voters
item.description: RNC Dallas spokesperson Zach Kraft told Newsmax that President Trump is taking the party's midterm message directly to voters.
